capabilityHints.summary: Presale contributors receive a proportional claim on the launched token once a soft-cap-gated raise finalizes; the raised ETH permanently seeds the canonical pool; long-term stakers earn ETH- and token-denominated rewards plus a decaying exit tax that favors patience; the protocol continuously recycles part of its own trading tax into buybacks and burns instead of only paying out to a treasury wallet.

components.summary: Seeds the single canonical full-range position from the raised ETH; custody is permanent and has no removal path.
The one fee-enforcing hook for the canonical pool: swap tax, LP-exit tax, staking rewards, buybacks and the mandatory Programmable fee.
Searches for the hook's CREATE2 salt and deploys it, both inside its own constructor, so the launch takes no off-chain parameter.
Soft-cap-gated presale. Its constructor creates the token, the bootstrapper and the hook deployer, so one deployment produces the whole launch.
Fixed 100,000,000 supply EGR, minted once to the presale and not claimable until finalize.
Selected Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager runtime dependency.

project.summary: A presale-funded Uniswap v4 launch whose custom hook taxes swaps and short-term LP exits to fund a staking reward stream, a treasury buyback-and-burn, and a stress-mode market-support mechanism.
project.title: Egregore
